Scheduler rule (Termal::Opus2, 2026-11-25). w-6ea6's Fix8 Windows FULL was READY at 16:22Z on 2026-11-24 and waited until 02:05Z. Nothing blocked it: there was no busy resource, no missing END, no wrong wake address, and no lapsed claim. Its entry simply fell out of the scheduler's queue: it last appears in the log line at 19:30:53Z and is gone by 21:11:34Z. The queue lived only as free text, retyped in each log line, and was rebuilt after the memory incidents and the cold-routing rule change. Rules:
(1) Keep the Central and DL560/WinB queues in ONE durable file, .tmp/q8111/central-queue.txt, with one line per entry.
(2) Remove an entry ONLY at its LAUNCH/SPAWN or on an explicit owner withdrawal, and record the reason.
(3) Re-read the file whenever a slot frees, never a remembered list.
(4) An entry that has waited more than 2 h gets an explicit check against free windows.

REV 2 addition (Fable2 #7791, 2026-11-25 04:50Z): rule (4), "an entry waiting more than 2 h gets an explicit check", also covers PARKED carriers that are not in the active queue. Examples are a combo candidate whose FULL never ran, a frozen batch whose base has moved, and any open integration item (for example w-b55fde7d6587 combo91, dropped after its 2026-11-21 freeze). They are listed in central-queue.txt under "PARKED / REVIVE" and checked with the same rule: revive them (re-cut on current master), or record an explicit withdrawal by their owner.
